reviews.text: Super adorable and fun roguelike deckbuilder. The general vibe is most similar to Cat God Ranch, and obviously inspired by Luck be a Landlord and Balatro. Also somewhat similar to a very small indie game called Crop Rotation, actually. Overall, a cute, easy and good time You have a bunch of plants that fill up a 9x9 field randomly based on their amount, you harvest a 3x3 square and are scored based on the plants in that square. There's a lot of modifications, archetypes and synergies. It's generally good, fast fun and presents a challenge pretty quickly as you go on higher difficulties. There's lots of cool modifiers, and it's all well crafted into a pleasant package. It's hard to say what makes games like these tick, but in the first few hours, it feels like the balance and vibes are appropriate. Would definitely recommend for fans of the genre. My main issue right now is the localization It's not as big of an issue as some non-English game designers but some effects are hard to parse, which obviously detracts from the game. Primarily, the Base x Mult thing is sort of unclear, and one of the upgrade animals tells you what it upgrades in Chinese. Editing to add: More issues have popped up. As expected of an indie game, there's some glitches. Achievements are triggering that I definitely did not do. The way difficulties are unlocked is a bit weird and unclear as well. Overall though, the game is well crafted, well made and fun. After playing quite a few hours, I'm reasonably certain I'll keep playing. The balance feels good, certainly on the more difficult end of things depending on the map. Would definite recommend getting it at this price.

Good variety of combinations. Some of which are broken but in a fun/satisfying way. The RNG, new unlocked plants, and harder levels will force you to try out other combinations, and finding those new combinations make you feel smart. I've perfected the achievements, so I'm probably done with this game, but it was well worth the money. Highly recommend if you're looking for a strategy game with depth but does not require full focus once you understand how things work.

I enjoyed this game like I enjoyed Balatro, which for this genre is high praise. This scratched the same itch for me, with similar amounts of RNG at the highest difficulty. My only wish is that during this early access period more achievements are added because I'm one of those people who enjoys pursuing whatever the developers consider the full completion of the game. With Balatro that took a considerably longer amount of time than with Chosen Garden (<30 hours vs 400+) but this game is still very early into early access. I look forward to the future development of the game, whether that involves adding a whole new set of gameplay (e.g. challenges, weekly/monthly scoreboards, etc.) or simply new maps!

种田与肉鸽，一个十分神奇的组合，本作通过分数这个巧妙的形式将其展现了出来，简单易上手的游戏玩法使人上瘾，再融入了温馨美好的场景画面塑造。这就是《天选花园》，别看这只是一款独立游戏，这其中的魅力可能超乎你的想象，在这里玩家们将体验到通过自己设计的组合打出高额得分的满足，享受一键收获所有作物的快感。第一次体验就上头游玩了好几个小时，期待制作组之后多增加一些肉鸽内容，相信本作会有更好的表现。
